author: eduardo90
quote: This is not GTA, it's a soulless project. 13 years and the best we got was graphics a little better than RDR2 or Cyberpunk.Lucia and Jason are the worst characters in the entire franchise. Even Claude has more personality. A lot of mechanics are downgrades compared to GTA V, like explosions and impacts. Missions are so poorly made that they look like they came from GTA Online. They didn't just censor the writing that made gta gta, but also cool mechanics that were a must have in all previous games. It will be a sucess of course, but rockstar lost the throne
